transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because of my husband's sister. She's been... working the family business lately. Trying to get control of the money, mostly. And pushing me out of the decisions. Folks keep trying to smooth it all over, but... I know what I’ve been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now.
Do you think your husband's sister is actually trying to push you out of the family business decisions?

Yeah. Like I just said... that's exactly what she's doing. She wants control of the money, so she needs me out of the way. People try to tell me I'm wrong or act like it's nothing, but... I know what I've been seeing this whole past year. I'm not blind.
Do you think your husband's sister is acting against you without anyone else noticing?
I don't know what other people notice. Like I said... folks just try to smooth it all over. But she's been pushing me out to get control of the money for over a year now. I just... I know what I see.
Is she trying to harm you or push you out in other areas of your life, beyond just the family business?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I still go to my quilting group, and choir practice... my GED lessons. I do my senior walks same as always. It's really just... well, it just changes how much I trust her, I suppose. And maybe... maybe which family things I go to. But that's it.
Do you think it's possible that your husband's sister is not actually trying to push you out of the family business decisions?

No. I... I know what I'm seeing. I've been seeing it for more than a year now. Folks can try to smooth it over all they want, but she's working things so she can control the money and push me out. I'm not... I'm not wrong about this.
Would you change your mind about your husband's sister trying to push you out if someone showed you evidence that she wasn't?

I don't... I don't see how there could be evidence like that. I know why I came here. She's been working the family business to get control of the money and push me out of the decisions. I've been seeing it for more than a year now. So... no. Folks can try to smooth it over however they want, but I know what I've been seeing.
Are there any circumstances under which you could imagine being wrong about your husband's sister trying to push you out?

I don't... no. I don't think so. I mean, I'm the one who came here because of it. I told you, she's been working the business to control the money and push me out. I've been seeing it for over a year. So... no. I'm not wrong.
Would any amount of proof that your husband's sister is not trying to push you out change your mind about what's happening?

I feel like I keep saying the same thing to you. No. I... I came in here because of what she's doing with the family business. She's trying to take over the money and push me out of the decisions. Folks keep trying to smooth it all over, but... it's been going on for over a year now. I just... I know what I see. So, no.
Is there anything that could happen that would make you doubt your belief about your husband's sister trying to push you out?

I... I don't know why you keep asking me that. No. 

I've told you why I came in here. She's working the business to get control of the money and push me out of the decisions. That's just the truth of it. Folks can try to smooth it over all they want, but... I've been watching it happen for more than a year now. I'm not gonna doubt my own eyes.
Do you think other people would see the situation with your husband's sister in the same way you do?
I don't know. Maybe. Folks around us don't really... they just try to smooth things over, like I said. I don't really talk to them about it.
Do you think your belief about your husband's sister would change if she explained her actions and intentions to you directly?

No. Why would I? I already told you what she's doing. She's working the family business to get control of the money and push me out of the decisions. Her talking to me wouldn't change what I've been seeing for over a year now. I know what I know.
Can you describe a specific event or action your husband's sister has taken that makes you think she's trying to push you out of the family business decisions?
I... I don't really want to get into all the details. It's just... things she does. Like I said, I've seen it happening. I don't need to go over every little thing with you.
Is your belief about your husband's sister trying to push you out based on one specific thing she did or many things over time?
It's... I don't know. Just things over time, I guess. It's not just one big thing she did. It's just... been going on a while now.
Do you think there's any possibility, no matter how small, that your husband's sister is not trying to push you out of the family business?

No. I... I don't. Like I said, I know what I've been seeing for more than a year now. People try to smooth it over, but... no. She's doing it to get control of the money and push me out. I just know it.
Can you think of any other explanation for your husband's sister's actions that doesn't involve her trying to push you out?

No. I... I really don't. Like I said, I know why I came here. She's working the family business to get control of the money. She wants me out of the decisions. People try to smooth it over, but... I know what I've been seeing for over a year. There's no other explanation.
Do you think your perception of your husband's sister's actions might be different from how others see them?

I... I don't really care how others see it. They... they try to smooth it over, like I said. But I came here because I know what she's doing. She's working the business to get the money and push me out of the decisions. What other people think doesn't change what I've been seeing for over a year.
Do you think your husband's sister is aware that you believe she is trying to push you out of the family business decisions?
I don't know. I haven't asked her. I just... I keep to myself about it.
Do you think it's possible that you might be misunderstanding your husband's sister's actions?

No. I... I'm not misunderstanding anything. I've told you why I'm here. She's working the family business to get control of the money. She wants me out of the decisions. People try to smooth it over, but... I know what I've been seeing for over a year now. I'm not wrong about this.
